description: Lists Fog cases: the users' devices running a room's server file (Fogs) computed different states, the majority won and the odd one's user was flagged (undecided: no majority, nobody flagged). Each gives room, seq, status (reassigned and annulled: already decided), each Fog's userId and verdict, the paths that differ and who is flagged. Kept 30 days. Read-only; neblla_decide_fog_case decides.

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

name: neblla_list_fog_cases
title: List Fog disagreements
